meta.siteDescription: APLOMB, a real estate agency dedicated to architect-designed houses, lofts and 20th-century heritage. Paris, Lyon, Basque Coast.

descriptions.properties: Architect-designed houses, modernist villas, lofts and exceptional penthouses for sale in France. Plans, 3D models and the story of each property.
descriptions.architects: The architects whose work APLOMB represents: Hélène Vasseur, Studio Ordinal, Kenji Arnaud, Atelier Lune, Bruno Salvat.
descriptions.sell: Entrust the sale of your architect-designed house to an agency that knows how to tell its story. Free online valuation.
descriptions.agency: Founded in 2009 by an architect, APLOMB sells houses for their architecture. Three offices: Paris, Lyon, Biarritz.
descriptions.journal: Guides, materials, places: APLOMB's journal on domestic architecture.
descriptions.contact: Contact APLOMB in Paris, Lyon or Biarritz about buying or selling.
descriptions.faq: Buying, selling, fees: answers to the most frequent questions.

hero.eyebrow: Architectural real estate — Paris · Lyon · Basque Coast
hero.title: The true
hero.intro: We sell houses for what they really are: works of architecture. Plans, models, story — every address is presented the way it was conceived.
hero.sceneLabel: 3D model of an architect-designed concrete and glass house with a pool, separating floor by floor as you scroll.

manifesto.text: An architect-designed house isn't sold by the square metre. It is sold by the light falling on a wall at four in the afternoon, by the proportion of a living room, by the intelligence of a plan. Since 2009, we learn every house before we show it.

featured.title: Current addresses
featured.intro: Every property is visited, measured, redrawn and told by our team before it is offered.

steps.title: Survey
steps.text: In-depth visit, measured survey, gathering of the architect's drawings and archives.

steps.title: Redraw
steps.text: Redrawn plans, 3D digital model, photo shoot in natural light.

steps.title: Tell
steps.text: The story of the house, a meeting with the architect, targeted and off-market marketing.

steps.title: Pass on
steps.text: Qualified viewings, negotiation, support through to the deed of sale.

planToStone.title: Understand before you visit
planToStone.text: Our redrawn plans let buyers read the house before stepping inside. The result: fewer viewings, but decisive ones.

architectsPage.intro: We don't sell floor space, we sell works. These are the architects whose houses we look after, often since their very first sale.

join.title: Are you an architect?
join.text: Do your clients wish to sell a house you designed? We'd be glad to talk it through with you.

sell.title: An authored house
sell.intro: We turn down about half of the listings we're offered. Those we accept, we sell in 74 days on average, at the asking price.

items.title: Redrawn plans
items.text: A full survey, legible plans and a 3D model for every exclusive listing.

items.title: The architect on board
items.text: We contact the house's author or their estate to document its history.

items.title: Chosen exposure
items.text: A network of qualified buyers, selective publications, and off-market whenever you wish.

form.title: Online valuation
form.intro: Three steps, two minutes. You get a first range immediately, then a detailed valuation after a visit.

result.title: Your house could sell for between
result.note: Indicative range based on sales of comparable properties. An advisor will contact you within 72 hours to arrange a visit and refine this valuation.

agency.title: Founded by
agency.intro: APLOMB was born of frustration: seeing remarkable houses sold like any other property, described by their number of bedrooms. We chose the opposite.
agency.manifesto: Aplomb: plumb, true, balanced. It is the question we ask of every house, and of every decision we make.

items.title: Accuracy
items.text: A reasoned price, neither inflated to win the listing nor cut to sell fast.

items.title: Knowledge
items.text: A team made up half of architects and architectural historians.

items.title: Discretion
items.text: A third of our sales happen without advertising, at the owners' request.

items.title: Transmission
items.text: Every house changes hands with its plans, its archives and its story.

agency.teamIntro: Architects, historians, negotiators: profiles rarely found in real estate.
agency.officesIntro: Three addresses, three territories. Meet us in person or by video.
